traditions.LXX: Συνέσεως τῷ Δαυείδ .
traditions.VUL: Ipsi David intelléctus .
traditions.KJV: [ A Psalm ] of David , Maschil .

1.english_reference: Blessed [ is he whose ] transgression [ is ] forgiven ,

traditions.LXX: Μακάριοι ὧν ἀφέθησαν αἱ ἀνομίαι ,
traditions.VUL: Beáti quorum remíssæ sunt iniquitátes :
traditions.KJV: Blessed [ is he whose ] transgression [ is ] forgiven , [ whose ]

traditions.LXX: καὶ ὧν ἐπεκαλύφθησαν αἱ ἁμαρτίαι .
traditions.VUL: et quorum tecta sunt peccáta .
traditions.KJV: sin [ is ] covered .

2.english_reference: Blessed [ is ] the man unto whom the LORD imputeth not iniquity ,

traditions.WLC: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי אָדָ֗ם לֹ֤א יַחְשֹׁ֬ב יְהוָ֣ה ל֣ וֹ עָוֺ֑ן
traditions.LXX: μακάριος ἀνὴρ οὗ οὐ μὴ λογίσηται Κύριος ἁμαρτίαν ,
traditions.VUL: Beátus vir , cui non imputávit Dóminus peccátum ,
traditions.KJV: Blessed [ is ] the man unto whom the LORD imputeth not iniquity ,

2.english_reference: and in whose spirit [ there is ] no guile .

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵ֖ין בְּ רוּח֣ וֹ רְמִיָּה
traditions.LXX: οὐδέ ἐστιν ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτοῦ δόλος .
traditions.VUL: nec est in spíritu eius dolus .
traditions.KJV: and in whose spirit [ there is ] no guile .

traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐσίγησα ,
traditions.VUL: Quóniam tácui ,
traditions.KJV: When I kept silence ,

3.english_reference: my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long .

traditions.WLC: בָּל֣וּ עֲצָמָ֑ י בְּ֝ שַׁאֲגָתִ֗ י כָּל הַ יּֽוֹם
traditions.LXX: ἐπαλαιώθη τὰ ὀστᾶ μου ἀπὸ τοῦ κράζειν με ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν .
traditions.VUL: inveteravérunt ossa mea , dum clamárem tota die .
traditions.KJV: my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long .

4.english_reference: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me :

traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י יוֹמָ֣ם וָ לַיְלָה֮ תִּכְבַּ֥ד עָלַ֗ י יָ֫דֶ֥ ךָ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτὸς ἐβαρύνθη ἐπ᾽ ἐμὲ ἡ χείρ σου ,
traditions.VUL: Quóniam die ac nocte graváta est super me manus tua :
traditions.KJV: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me :

4.english_reference: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer .

traditions.WLC: נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ לְשַׁדִּ֑ י בְּ חַרְבֹ֖נֵי קַ֣יִץ
traditions.LXX: ἐστράφην εἰς ταλαιπωρίαν ἐν τῷ ἐνπαγῆναι ἄκανθαν .
traditions.VUL: convérsus sum in ærúmna mea , dum confígitur spina .
traditions.KJV: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer .

traditions.LXX: διάψαλμα .
traditions.KJV: Selah .

5.english_reference: I acknowledged my sin unto thee ,

traditions.LXX: τὴν ἁμαρτίαν μου ἐγνώρισα ,
traditions.VUL: Delíctum meum cógnitum tibi feci :
traditions.KJV: I acknowledged my sin unto thee ,

5.english_reference: and mine iniquity have I not hid .

traditions.LXX: καὶ τὴν ἀνομίαν μου οὐκ ἐκάλυψα ·
traditions.VUL: et iniustítiam meam non abscóndi .
traditions.KJV: and mine iniquity have I not hid .

5.english_reference: I said , I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD ;

traditions.WLC: אָמַ֗רְתִּי אוֹדֶ֤ה עֲלֵ֣י פְ֭שָׁעַ י לַ יהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: εἶπα Ἐξαγορεύσω κατ᾽ ἐμοῦ τὴν ἁμαρτίαν μου τῷ κυρίῳ ,
traditions.VUL: Dixi : Confitébor advérsum me iniustítiam meam Dómino :
traditions.KJV: I said , I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD ;

5.english_reference: and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin .

traditions.WLC: וְ אַתָּ֨ה נָ֘שָׂ֤אתָ עֲוֺ֖ן חַטָּאתִ֣ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ σὺ ἀφῆκας τὴν ἀσέβειαν τῆς καρδίας μου .
traditions.VUL: et tu remisísti impietátem peccáti mei .
traditions.KJV: and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin .

traditions.LXX: διάψαλμα .
traditions.KJV: Selah .

6.english_reference: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found :

traditions.WLC: עַל זֹ֡את יִתְפַּלֵּ֬ל כָּל חָסִ֨יד אֵלֶי ךָ֮ לְ עֵ֪ת מְ֫צֹ֥א
traditions.LXX: ὑπὲρ ταύτης προσεύξεται πᾶς ὅσιος πρὸς σὲ ἐν καιρῷ εὐθέτῳ ·
traditions.VUL: Pro hac orábit ad te omnis sanctus , in témpore opportúno .
traditions.KJV: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found :

6.english_reference: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him .

traditions.WLC: רַ֗ק לְ֭ שֵׁטֶף מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים אֵ֝לָ֗י ו לֹ֣א יַגִּֽיעוּ
traditions.LXX: πλὴν ἐν κατακλυσμῷ ὑδάτων πολλῶν πρὸς αὐτὸν οὐκ ἐγγιοῦσιν
traditions.VUL: Verúmtamen in dilúvio aquárum multárum , ad eum non approximábunt .
traditions.KJV: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him .

traditions.LXX: σύ μου εἶ καταφυγὴ
traditions.VUL: Tu es refúgium meum
traditions.KJV: Thou [ art ] my hiding place ;

7.english_reference: thou shalt preserve me from trouble ;

traditions.LXX: ἀπὸ θλίψεως τῆς περιεχούσης με ·
traditions.VUL: a tribulatióne , quæ circúmdedit me :
traditions.KJV: thou shalt preserve me from trouble ;

7.english_reference: thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance .

traditions.LXX: τὸ ἀγαλλίαμά μου , λύτρωσαί με ἀπὸ τῶν κυκλωσάντων με .
traditions.VUL: exsultátio mea , érue me a circumdántibus me .
traditions.KJV: thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance .

traditions.LXX: διάψαλμα .
traditions.KJV: Selah .

8.english_reference: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go :

traditions.WLC: אַשְׂכִּֽילְ ךָ֨ וְֽ אוֹרְ ךָ֗ בְּ דֶֽרֶךְ ז֥וּ תֵלֵ֑ךְ
traditions.LXX: συνετιῶ σε καὶ συνβιβῶ σε ἐν ὁδῷ ταύτῃ ᾗ πορεύσῃ ,
traditions.VUL: Intelléctum tibi dabo , et ínstruam te in via hac , qua gradiéris :
traditions.KJV: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go :

8.english_reference: I will guide thee with mine eye .

traditions.LXX: ἐπιστηριῶ ἐπὶ σὲ τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου .
traditions.VUL: firmábo super te óculos meos .
traditions.KJV: I will guide thee with mine eye .

9.english_reference: Be ye not as the horse , [ or ] as the mule , [ which ] have no understanding :

traditions.WLC: אַל תִּֽהְי֤וּ כְּ ס֥וּס כְּ פֶרֶד֮ אֵ֤ין הָ֫בִ֥ין
traditions.LXX: μὴ γίνεσθε ὡς ἵππος καὶ ἡμίονος , οἷς οὐκ ἔστιν σύνεσις ·
traditions.VUL: Nolíte fíeri sicut equus et mulus , quibus non est intelléctus .
traditions.KJV: Be ye not as the horse , [ or ] as the mule , [ which ] have no understanding :

9.english_reference: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle ,

traditions.WLC: בְּ מֶֽתֶג וָ רֶ֣סֶן עֶדְי֣ וֹ לִ בְל֑וֹם
traditions.LXX: ἐν χαλινῷ καὶ κημῷ τὰς σιαγόνας αὐτῶν ἄγξαι
traditions.VUL: In camo et freno maxíllas eórum constrínge ,
traditions.KJV: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle ,

9.english_reference: lest they come near unto thee .

traditions.LXX: τῶν μὴ ἐγγιζόντων πρὸς σέ .
traditions.VUL: qui non appróximant ad te .
traditions.KJV: lest they come near unto thee .

10.english_reference: Many sorrows [ shall be ] to the wicked :

traditions.LXX: πολλαὶ αἱ μάστιγες τοῦ ἁμαρτωλοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Multa flagélla peccatóris :
traditions.KJV: Many sorrows [ shall be ] to the wicked :

10.english_reference: but he that trusteth in the LORD , mercy shall compass him about .

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ בּוֹטֵ֥חַ בַּ יהוָ֑ה חֶ֝֗סֶד יְסוֹבְבֶֽ נּוּ
traditions.LXX: τὸν δὲ ἐλπίζοντα ἐπὶ Κύριον ἔλεος κυκλώσει .
traditions.VUL: sperántem autem in Dómino misericórdia circúmdabit .
traditions.KJV: but he that trusteth in the LORD , mercy shall compass him about .

traditions.LXX: εὐφράνθητε ἐπὶ Κύριον
traditions.VUL: Lætámini in Dómino ,
traditions.KJV: Be glad in the LORD ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀγαλλιᾶσθε , δίκαιοι ·
traditions.VUL: et exsultáte iusti ,
traditions.KJV: and rejoice , ye righteous :

11.english_reference: and shout for joy , all [ ye that are ] upright in heart

traditions.LXX: καὶ καυχᾶσθε , πάντες οἱ εὐθεῖς τῇ καρδίᾳ .
traditions.VUL: et gloriámini omnes recti corde .
traditions.KJV: and shout for joy , all [ ye that are ] upright in heart .
